# Getting help

- **Docs:** start at [unboundforce.dev](https://unboundforce.dev), which
  covers getting started, every project and the reference material.
- **Questions and ideas:** ask in
  [Discussions on the unbound-force repo](https://github.com/unbound-force/unbound-force/discussions),
  or open an issue on the repo the question is about.
- **Bugs and feature requests:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Security problems:** don't open a public issue. See
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
